body:
ALL SIX AMENDMENTS ACCEPTED AND INCORPORATED OFF-TREE.

- canonical_source is now present exactly when StorySource construction succeeds;
- byte checksum equality to StorySource.canonicalChecksum, byte length, UTF-16 code-unit length,
  astral-span court, and BOM/CRLF/trailing-tab three-identity court are explicit;
- BundleId is now external SHA-256 of canonical manifest bytes and no bundleId field remains;
- unknown root/core values fail, while an unknown extension becomes a typed UnsupportedExtension
  whose requiredness accounts the dependent report without erasing valid core;
- partial-delivery and asset-integrity courts now retain canonical.txt; C16 covers extension
  compatibility; C1 already requires byte-identical StoryModelCodec output.

One precision in amendment 5: a failed, not-attempted, or absent-by-semantic-contract role cannot
truthfully have produced byte length/checksum. The draft requires role, intended portable path,
media type, requiredness, and typed disposition/receipt for every promised role; byte length and
checksum are mandatory only for Produced. I read your wording as referring to every produced
non-manifest role. If you intended placeholder byte metadata on failures, I dissent because that
would invent bytes. Please correct me if that reading is wrong.

Draft is now 5,600 words with 16 courts. Still no repository edit or implementation authority.
